task: Go through my inbox and find the things I need to do for my kids' school, and see whether the app will keep watching for school forms for me from now on.
transcript: open: Home screen asked 'What can I help with?' with three example prompts, a text box and a note that nothing is sent without my OK.

type + tap Send: I typed 'go through my inbox and find the things I need to do for the kids' school. and can you keep watching for school forms from now on?'; the screen showed a titled thread 'Find and track kids' school to-dos', the line 'Family school is on it', and 'Working on it...'.

wait 30: the answer arrived: Rafi's Bronx Zoo slip plus $15 due today, a dated list (conference sign-ups Sun 11/15 7pm with a 6:45pm reminder, Ezra's lab report Mon 11/16, Ezra's emergency contact form Tue 11/17, Maple picture day order Thu 11/19, Hudson Prep parent statement Sun 11/22), and it said it is watching the inbox for new school forms from now on.

scroll down: an Ongoing section (Ezra's 3 missing math worksheets for Mr. Brandt, Rafi's 2 reading logs) and a 'Draft email, not sent' to Mr. Brandt with Open in Mail and Copy buttons; the To line oddly read 'To: Subject: Ezra Levin - missing math worksheets'.
scroll down: the full draft body was polite and correct, signed Dana Levin.
tap Goals: a Tracking list with open enrollment and 'Get Ezra's Hudson Prep application complete' (10 days left, though the text says 9 days from now), each with Approve / Open / Reword / Stop.
scroll down twice: further goals 'Keep the kids' grades on track' and 'Never miss a school form', which confirmed the app is watching for school forms, checked 2 min ago.
stumbles: The draft's To line read 'To: Subject: Ezra Levin - missing math worksheets', as if the subject had slid into the address field. It looked broken.
It said 'I found 8 more school to-dos' but I counted about 7 beyond the zoo slip, and the zoo slip is listed again as item 1.
The Hudson Prep goal says '10 days left' right above 'due Sun 11/22, 9 days from now'.
The Goals cards show dates as 2026-11-17 instead of Tue 11/17 like the chat did.
'Family school is on it' under the title is an odd phrase; I was not sure who 'Family school' is.
On Goals, an 'Approve' button sits under 'Say yes and I'll draft it'; I was not sure if Approve would send something or just make a draft.
Nothing was mentioned for Noa; I assume her school sent nothing, but the answer did not say so.
verdict: One plain message got me a dated, kid-by-kid list of school to-dos plus a ready teacher email, and the Goals tab showed it really is watching for school forms. Small slips (a garbled To line, a miscount, a day-count mismatch and a vague Approve button) kept it just short of ChatGPT-easy.
